name: [ ENLIL'S ENIGMA ]
source:
adulthood didn't go as you expected it to. you come back to your childhood's home hoping that it would at least make you nostalgic. after all, your family is still there. even with the new technologies, things haven't really changed in that farm, have they?

...have they?

[From [url=https://lenlen403.itch.io/enlils-enigma]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
成年后的生活并未如你所愿。你回到了儿时的老家，指望着至少能在这里重温旧梦。毕竟，你的家人还住在那里。就算有了种种新技术，那座农场里的一切也并没有真正改变，不是吗？

……不是吗？

[摘自[url=https://lenlen403.itch.io/enlils-enigma]itch.io[/url]]
